conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: Semantic search/embeddings demonstration with synonym payment examples
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Alphabetically ordered vocabulary TF-IDF vectors, normalized and represented by dense arrays but semantically sparse; no neural encoder. Payment transaction was declined by the bank vs My credit card charge did not go through have disjoint whitespace tokens, so the mathematical cosine is zero under this exact demo contract.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Keep lexical baseline and vector interface; never report it as trained semantic retrieval. Use existing NLP01 implementation for math and preprocessing; distinguish zero/OOV from no answer.

conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Slices the prefix of alphabetically sorted TF-IDF dimensions. No multi-prefix representation loss/training. Truncation only checks one query-document cosine, not recall.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Treat as arbitrary truncation counterexample; preserve existing engineering07 true MRL objective and task-level validation.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: Binary quantization uses 1 bit and 32x storage reduction
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: binarize returns numpy int8 / Uint8Array, one byte per component, not packed bits. Float base numpy default is float64, TS numbers are not float32 arrays. Storage printouts assume float32 and ideal bit packing. Nonnegative TF-IDF binarization equals term presence.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Separate actual nbytes, packed ceiling(d/8), original-vector storage used for rescoring, metadata and index overhead; implement signed synthetic vectors+bit packing only at later writing/verification stage.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: Same search architecture works after swapping embedder
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Source Python chunk loops lack size/overlap validation; overlap>=size can fail to advance. TS04 checks positive size and overlap<size but not integer/nonnegative overlap; TS06 clamps stride so it may silently accept an invalid contract. TS metrics truncate to shorter vector length; repeated index_documents in 04 refits vocabulary but appends old-space vectors.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Reuse existing Study dimension/finite/zero and chunk validation; reset/rebuild indexes with a frozen encoder contract; do not copy these entrypoints as production adapters.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: RAG always wins factual knowledge, guarantees freshness/citations/privacy; fine-tuning always costs thousands; temperature 0 addresses hallucination
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: These are uncaveated decision rules and illustrative prices; retrieved documents can be stale/wrong, prompt may expose documents to a provider, citations may not support the answer, and temperature 0 is not a correctness guarantee.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Preserve task-driven Prompt/RAG/FT comparison; track data permissions, effective revisions, costs and generation evidence. Do not transplant prices or guarantees.

conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: No external embedding, vector DB or LLM; extraction selects sentence with maximal non-stopword overlap. Python extracts query from the last question: delimiter in the prompt; TS uses question directly. Splitting at periods can fragment decimal values and sentences. Source metadata is returned beside chunks, but prompt cites ordinal Source N without linking source ID/revision/range.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Use a named extractive fixture backend for pipeline plumbing; save query, per-stage IDs and final context; unknown/no-answer and source verification distinct from lexical score. No actual generator quality claimed.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: Semantic chunking and default 256-512 tokens; overlap prevents sentence splitting; bigger/smaller guaranteed effects
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: 06 calls paragraph/section boundaries semantic chunking, 04 uses embedding distance; source code counts whitespace words, not tokens. Overlap may still split a sentence; source quality tables and sweet spots are not local experiments.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Keep existing engineering12 structural/semantic distinction and exact offsets/budgets; all chunk choices are controlled hypotheses, not predetermined exercise answers.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: Semantic+BM25 hybrid, cross-attention reranking, HyDE bridges meaning gap
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Vector leg is TF-IDF; both legs are lexical. Reranker is word overlap/bigrams/substring position and initial-score heuristic. HyDE is fixed generic text templates, not generated plausible content. Source summary mentions cross-attention but code contains no such model.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Name all three substitutes precisely; preserve valid BM25/RRF algorithm; only characterize real learned reranking/HyDE after a separately authorized model experiment.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: Parent-child preserves sufficient document context and evaluation catches hallucinations
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Demo concatenates six documents before splitting, so parents can cross source boundaries and carry no document/version/permission IDs. Faithfulness counts content-word substrings anywhere in concatenated context at a .5 threshold; 90-day vs 60-day can share enough words to pass, and no answer sentences returns 1.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Expand children only to same-document/revision/permission parent and deduplicate under budget. For support checks reuse engineering06 explicit supported/unsupported/unknown labels and counterexamples; no-factual-claim or empty output must not gain fake full faithfulness.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: All retrieval uses bi-encoders; hybrid always used and costs nothing; cross-encoders 100-1000x slower; hybrid wins >=3/5 and HyDE improves vague queries
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: BM25 does not use a bi-encoder; costs, latency and quality depend on corpus/hardware/model/protocol. Reranking cannot recover omitted candidates. Source code comparison checks top-1 source category HIT only, not precise evidence or full Recall@k despite providing an unused recall helper.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Freeze candidate budgets and gold granularity; log stage failures and reject promised winners. Performance constants and colloquial asymptotic claims discarded.

conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Real PyTorch autograd, frozen nn.Linear weights, trainable A/B, AdamW and loss.backward. It uses an untrained small MLP and random inputs/one-hot random labels under MSE, not pretrained causal LM tokens. Newly initialized bases in rank loop differ, so rank comparison is confounded.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Do not call its gradients fake or simulation. Keep low-rank/autograd mechanic while label task as toy MLP. Later independent probe should clone identical base/teacher/data/splits, verify W unchanged and A/B gradients, and report held-out behavior separately.

conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Uniform block scale absmax/7, round and clamp(-8,7) into int8, no nonuniform NF4 codebook. quantize_model immediately stores dequantized floating tensors in model parameters; simulated integer state is an extra object. No packed nibbles, double quantization or paged optimizer. Memory print omits biases/resident floating copy/training states/activations.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Rename explanation to uniform quantize-dequantize error probe, keep true NF4/QLoRA definition from primary/official docs, do not claim 4-bit live model or VRAM savings.

conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: For row-vector code A is [in,r], B [r,out], output xAB*(alpha/r), and linear.weight gets (AB).T*scale; correct orientation is different from column-vector paper notation. Saved rank/alpha are ignored during load. Demo correctly copies same base for save/load equality but later multiple adapters are separate model copies, not one live base switching adapters.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Keep orientation/scaling explicit; verify init equivalence, B-first gradient, base freeze, merge equality and reload on exact base/config; reject shape/rank/scale/base-revision mismatch. Do not claim hardware speedup or live shared-base serving.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: 56GB to 6GB LoRA; within1% full FT; target q/v always optimal; <=3epochs/rank-by-task; complete Trainer after raw Alpaca loading
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Quiz conflates LoRA with quantized base: fp16 8B weights alone need about16GB before other memory. Raw Alpaca fields are not already tokenized input_ids/labels; snippet omits training preprocessing/collator/masks. Real memory/performance numbers depend on protocol. PEFT quantization docs include prepare_model_for_kbit_training and QLoRA-style all-linear targets.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Retain existing SFT/mask/old-ref/reward content and dates. Add qualified low-rank experiment/actual compatibility contract, not new hardware/model recommendations, fixed recipe or incomplete downloadable training script.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: LLM-as-judge with reasoning and model versions
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: SIMULATED_MODELS returns canned templates. Scores depend on output length, reference/input word overlap, unsafe substrings and deterministic MD5 buckets. Reasoning is rubric text. Docs use Python hash() rather than main MD5, creating a seed discrepancy. Same repeated input/output produces identical main score.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Use as an evaluation runner fixture only, never actual semantic grader/model comparison. Do not run unchanged three-rater exercise to report calibrated reliability.

conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: compare_eval_runs separately gathers criterion arrays with no ID matching, computes separate pseudo-LCG bootstrap intervals, then labels diff<-0.3 REGRESSION; CI is not used to decide. Missing criteria and differing case sets can silently disappear. No outcomes deadline/fee gate/CI execution. Overlap of separate confidence intervals does not decide a paired-difference test.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Preserve existing engineering06 paired-bootstrap and full denominator/case diff; add Wilson proportions and objective-specific thresholds without universal200-case/5% detectability promises. No significant-regression or real CI gate claim for this code.

conflicts_and_boundaries.claim: Random50d words approximate BERTScore; pairwise removes biases; human correlation100%; fixed judge agreement/cost/speed
conflicts_and_boundaries.actual: Random vectors have no pretrained contextual semantic meaning; pairwise still has order/verbosity/self preference and ties; humans can disagree; figures and cost/correlation tables are unverified and internally differ across docs/outputs.
conflicts_and_boundaries.disposition: Route text metric formulas to existing NLP05; route statistical fundamentals to data-science03; define actual judge calibration rather than copy numerical claims.
